content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

On the surface, options like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle seem like viable alternatives to Stripe. However, these platforms are still dependent on the same underlying infrastructure as Stripe, limiting your ability to truly own and control your commerce operations. They also come with their own set of fees, ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 5% per transaction, depending on the platform. Furthermore, these platforms often have strict policies around what types of digital products can be sold, and may even restrict the payment methods available to your customers. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack allows you to build, deploy, and scale your own commerce operations, without the need for third-party services. This means you can choose your own payment methods, fee structures, and product offerings, giving you complete control over your business.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

One of the biggest drawbacks of using platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle is the restrictions they place on countries where they operate. While Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195, many countries are still off-limits, including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan. This means that digital creators in these countries are forced to look for alternative payment solutions, often resulting in a patchwork of workarounds and expensive fees. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack allows you to sell digital products to customers in any country, without the need for a Stripe or PayPal account. This makes it an ideal solution for digital creators in restricted countries, who can finally sell their products without the hassle of third-party payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack offers a significant advantage over traditional payment processors. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin and Ethereum, with a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction. This not only reduces your fees but also provides your customers with a wide range of payment options. In contrast, traditional payment processors often charge higher fees, ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 5% per transaction, and may even have slower payment processing times. By using a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack, you can reduce your fees, increase your payment speed, and provide your customers with a better experience.
A sovereign commerce infrastructure stack is the only way to truly own and control your commerce operations.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A key advantage of a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack is the ability to own, automate, and deliver your digital products. With a stack like the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a fully operational online store in just 48 hours, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means you can focus on creating and selling digital products, rather than worrying about the underlying infrastructure. In contrast, traditional payment processors often require you to rely on third-party services for payment processing, delivery, and ownership, limiting your control and autonomy. By using a sovereign commerce infrastructure stack, you can automate your commerce operations, reduce your costs, and increase your efficiency.
